text_block_list.name: Student Council Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, did this get approved?
—Isn't the presentation a bit lacking? We need more...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You're smirking.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I was simply reminiscing about the past.
About what happened back then—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I couldn't grasp what the President was thinking, and the newcomer was sloppy with her work...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No, I must not fret. It is simply up to me to guide everyone properly!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: U-Um, Air Groove-senpai...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hm? Ah, it's you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You came to consult with me yesterday as well.
How is it? Were you able to shake off that off-feeling in your running?

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Well, about that. I tried the method you suggested,
but my final spurt still isn't working out...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see... All right, we shall explore other avenues.
Meet me at the turf track after school.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It seems you have been consulting with the same girl for several days in a row.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, we have yet to reach a solution.
Even with counseling, and researching various methods...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps she has grown intimidated after a string of consecutive losses.
She clearly has the will to run, but something just isn't clicking.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm. In that case—
why not leave it to "her"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Leave it to... Narita Brian?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm not fond of babysitting.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I do not expect that of you either.
All you need to do is run alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That alone is enough.
...For that is precisely the reason why I chose you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Here I come!
RAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kh, she's so fast... She's going to pass me...!
N-No way... I'm getting overtaken again...!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Overtaken, again...—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Don't take your eyes off your prey!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What is it you're trying to hunt?!
Didn't you come here to make the kill?!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Not yet! Not by a long shot!!
I don't want it to end here, dammiiiit!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*, kh, guuuuh...!
Aaaah, dammit!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You've finally shown your true colors.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! When you pulled up next to me, senpai, I felt chills run down my spine... and realized I still want to run!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I want to become strong like that! Piercing straight ahead, like you...!
This was no time to be frightened looking at who's beside me!

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: It made me feel like I don't want to lose to anyone—not even to myself—until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Narita Brian, forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
An overwhelming fighting spirit, the sheer brilliance of pure instinct—
Without question, there are many horse girls who will be guided forward by your back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: No need to apologize. It's true that I'm rough around the edges.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...And another thing I've been thinking for a while.
Stop calling me by my full name. It's too long.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
My apologies to you as well, President.
It was my failing not to place full faith in your discerning eye.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, that very trait is what makes you who you are.
My utterly dependable right hand.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Now then, allow me to say it once more.
Thank you for joining the student council.
I will be counting on you going forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It was at that moment our strides finally aligned... and...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, Laurel?
Where did Brian go?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, Brian-chan asked me to stand here in her place!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
It was utterly fascinating.
Thank you so much for sharing such a wonderful story♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Don't you agree? You were listening quite intently as well.
choice_data_list: I'm sorry for listening without asking!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Making excuses is unsightly, you fool.
If you're going to try and play dumb, do it more convincingly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though I received a scolding, hearing the secret origins of the student council's formation made me feel like I gained something special.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I will commend you for apologizing honestly.
Though eavesdropping is hardly something to be praised for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel gave me a playful wink.
Just as she said, hearing such an intriguing tale left me feeling very rewarded.
